summary:
DEFINITIVE audit of the frozen audited content identified by audited_content_sha256 = 2c5e4afb71fb7799abcde916a246ae9a1737c8b00b9f3b7534dffb7206a3f8e4 (31 files), whose tree is bound to commit 56fcb796e72ade2052867e62a41b36ff497dd59f on branch feat/rtl-wmbus-1.1.0 with a verified-clean worktree. Against merge-base with origin/main the PR changes 32 files = archives/r/rtl-wmbus/** 15 (12 version-level + 3 software-level) + knowledge/drafts/** 16 (8 pairs) + .gitignore 1. verdict=pass with 0 P0 / 0 P1 / 0 P2 / 0 P3 FOR THE W4 6-ROUND AUDIT ITSELF. Findings raised afterwards are deliberately NOT folded into `counts`: the local AI review's 1 P1 + 3 P2 sit in post_local_review_remediation.findings, and this round's re-verification found one further blocking R39/PF7 defect (now fixed) recorded in post_review_reverification. All six R5 findings are confirmed FIXED at the audited content and no regression was found in the package-side rules.

=== R5 FINDINGS — ALL SIX VERIFIED FIXED ===
(1) U+FFFD corruption: VERIFIED FIXED. Byte-level scan of all 15 files under archives/r/rtl-wmbus/ plus the 16 files of the 8 draft pairs found 0 occurrences of EF BF BD; every file also decodes as strict UTF-8. knowledge/drafts/E431-draft-EAA6.kv:20 and .md:27 now read the sentence correctly ("...命令行赋值优先级最高会使 BRANCH:= 失效、分支前缀不被清掉，横幅多出前缀。").
(2) archives/r/rtl-wmbus/manifest.yaml display: VERIFIED FIXED. Line 2 carries `display: "rtl-wmbus"`; all mandatory fields of knowledge/ARCHIVE-SPEC.md 4.1 are present (software, display, description, category, versions) and the optional homepage/license are filled. Field name, placement and quoting match templates/manifest-software.yaml.
(3) drafts committed: VERIFIED FIXED. `git status --porcelain knowledge/drafts` -> "" (empty), full-tree `git status --porcelain` -> "" (empty), and `git ls-tree -r HEAD knowledge/drafts` lists all 16 files. `git show --stat HEAD` (40b4dd4315) shows all 16 draft files plus conanfile.py, ohos_special_test.c and archives/r/rtl-wmbus/manifest.yaml — 19 files, no stray working-tree edits.
(4) ohos_special_test.c check list vs code: VERIFIED FIXED, proven empirically not just by reading. On a native (non-OHOS) build the binary emits exactly 8 checks; compiled with the gated path force-enabled (-DTARGET_IS_OHOS_AARCH64=1) it emits exactly 13 checks. That matches the header comment's "13 total on an OHOS build" and its 8-always-run / 5-gated split, with the -f flow-control block contributing two separately-counted assertions (lines 360 and 363). MANIFEST.yml assertion_count 32 == 19 (test_decode) + 13 (ohos_special_test) is arithmetically consistent.
(5) ELF image-length guard: VERIFIED FIXED. needed_sonames() returns -1 before touching Elf64_Ehdr when `sz < (long)sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr)` (lines 145-148, before the cast at 148), and main() gates its header assertions on the identical condition (line 244: `if (!img || sz < (long)sizeof(Elf64_Ehdr))`). Program-header bounds are separately validated in both places.
(6) conanfile.py docstring: VERIFIED FIXED. The module docstring (line 27) now says the values are injected "via `GnuToolchain(self).extra_env`", and the generate() comment (lines 73-75) states it explicitly: "Conan >=2.29 exposes `tc.extra_env` (not the older `tc.vars`)". Verified against installed conan 2.29.1: GnuToolchain.__init__ sets `self.extra_env = Environment()` and `_initialize_default_extra_env()` calls `self.extra_env.define(...)`; there is no `vars` attribute. The docstring now agrees with generate(), which calls tc.extra_env.define() for BRANCH/TAG/COMMIT_HASH/CHANGES.

=== PACKAGE-SIDE RULES RE-CONFIRMED (no regression) ===
R34 (test_package genuinely exercises the package) — CLEAN, and independently proven. The IQ fixture was decoded from the committed base64 text: 159759 B of pure base64 -> 118261 B gzip -> exactly 180224 raw bytes, byte-identical to the first 180224 bytes of upstream samples/rtlsdr_868.625M_2M4_issue48.cu8 in the official 1.1.0 tag archive. A real end-to-end `conan create` (native Linux/clang15, scratch copy, repo untouched) exited 0: source download + sha256 check, `Calling generate()`, `RUN: make release CC="clang" -j1`, `Building 1.1.0`, package bin/rtl_wmbus, then test() executing both binaries -> test_decode 19 checks / 0 failures and ohos_special_test 8 checks / 0 failures. test_decode fork/execs the packaged rtl_wmbus and asserts real decoded WM-Bus fields (2 lines, every line T1;1;1 CRC-checked, meter address 60168569, exact payload hex 0x29446850..., positive RSSI), plus -V banner, invalid-arg exit 1, -p T/-p S filtering and empty-stdin tolerance. The OHOS-gated assertions are demonstrably non-vacuous: force-enabled against a host glibc x86-64 artifact they produced 4 genuine FAILs (e_machine 62 vs 183, wrong PT_INTERP, glibc sonames libm.so.6/libc.so.6). The -f flow-control probe really fired ("rtl_wmbus: exiting since incoming data stopped flowing!" after 5 s), proving the alarm(5)+SIGALRM POSIX path is exercised.
R33 (compiler from Conan conf; no bare ${CC}/${CFLAGS} in self.run()) — CLEAN. build() reads `self.conf.get("tools.build:compiler_executables")` and falls back to "clang", then overrides on the make command line (`CC=gcc` in the upstream Makefile is a plain assignment that would shadow an inherited value). AST scan with comments and docstrings stripped: zero `${...}` / `$VAR` shell references and zero os.environ writes in all three Python files; the single `${CC}` occurrence is inside the explanatory comment at line 83. The e2e log shows `RUN: make release CC="clang" -j1` and conangnutoolchain.sh exporting CC from conf.
R32 (settings.os checked with `in ("Linux","OHOS")`) — CLEAN. Line 58: `if self.settings.os not in ("Linux", "OHOS")` plus an OHOS armv8 guard at line 61.
R39 (official source URL) — was a REAL VIOLATION of this audited content until this round corrected it; now CLEAN. See post_review_reverification for the reproduction. conandata.yml now declares one single quoted official source URL `https://github.com/wmbusmeters/rtl-wmbus/archive/refs/tags/1.1.0.tar.gz`. Measured on the audited content: zero plain `http://` sources and zero mirror/proxy hosts (gh-proxy, ghfast, ghproxy, gitclone, moeyy, kkgithub, fastgit, cnb.cool) in ANY changed file. CORRECTION to the previous revision of this report, which recorded this rule CLEAN on the strength of a grep that did not exempt the file's own `url:` list: conandata.yml did carry `https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/...` as its FIRST entry, which preflight PF7 rejects with "镜像前缀 gh-proxy.com（CI 自动加镜像回退，手写即 R39 违规 579 例）". Worth recording for future maintainers: PF7 scans only the conandata.yml/manifest.yaml changed *in this PR*, so the 682 pre-existing main packages that still carry hand-written mirrors are grandfathered and are NOT precedent for a new change. conandata.yml deliberately keeps no bare URL in comments because the CI pre-download step regex-rewrites every URL it finds (comments included).
R4/R9 (no fabricated sha256, no forced pass) — CLEAN. Independently downloaded the official tarball: sha256 = 0da72c7f5b026a4c0d8dc9beabba021f147c950f52eb8e09f4e41884d4f32ebf, matching conandata.yml and manifest.yaml exactly (64 hex chars, not all-zero/all-f). `git refs/tags/1.1.0` resolves to commit 34684e655df70867ac86e799561ec6512c45be0a, matching conandata.yml `commit:` and the -V banner assertion. No `def test(): pass`, no os.system, no commented-out cmake.test(); test() really runs two binaries.
R37 (version 1.1.0 = upstream tag, matches version dir) — CLEAN. recipe name/version = rtl-wmbus/1.1.0, version directory 1.1.0, commands.json ref rtl-wmbus/1.1.0, tag archive 1.1.0, and upstream tag 1.1.0 verified via the GitHub API. First adaptation, so no version-suffix requirement.
R38 (commands.json at software level) — CLEAN. archives/r/rtl-wmbus/commands.json present at the software level (not in the version dir), parses as valid JSON, name "rtl-wmbus" matches manifest.yaml software, type "tool", versions["1.1.0"].ref = "rtl-wmbus/1.1.0" aligned with the recipe, `"binary": false` consistent with status `built` (not yet uploaded), 2-space indent, no trailing comma.
R3 (honest status) — CLEAN. status `built` on both the software-level and version-level manifests, correctly meaning verified-but-not-uploaded; no claim of `published`. build_date 2026-10-01.
R19/R6/R02 (no committed binary, no generated files modified) — CLEAN. No NUL byte in any of the 32 changed files; the ~160 KB IQ fixture is base64 text (validated charset `[A-Za-z0-9+/=\n]`, 76-column lines, trailing newline). No patches/ directory and patches_applied: [] — correct, since upstream 1.1.0 cross-compiles unmodified. R8 respected: zero __OHOS__ / platform macros introduced.
W2 (PR atomicity) — CLEAN. Exactly one archives/ package touched (rtl-wmbus). 16 of the remaining changed files are knowledge/drafts, which are not framework files and are the repo's established practice (20 recent commits touch knowledge/drafts); the 32nd is `.gitignore` (2 negation lines, see R21 above). generate's W2 warning is informational only.
R21 (framework file boundary) — CLEAN on the forbidden list, with ONE root-file exception that the previous revision of this report failed to disclose. Zero changes to SKILL.md, references/, templates/, scripts/, ci/ or index.tsv. The PR does touch one root file, `.gitignore`, adding exactly two negation lines (`!archives/r/rtl-wmbus/1.1.0/reports/` and `!archives/r/rtl-wmbus/1.1.0/reports/audit-result.json`) without which R52 could not bind this report at all, because reports/ is gitignored repo-wide. Those two lines are what make .gitignore the 32nd changed file. Judgement, not an excuse: `.gitignore` is absent from R21's forbidden list, is explicitly whitelisted by the G0e root-directory check (G0_ROOT_ALLOWED in ci/conan/build_and_test.sh), and 35 identical per-package reports/ exception pairs already exist on main, contributed by package MRs (for example rocksdb 8.7.3 and openssl 3.5.8.1). Stated here explicitly so a reviewer is never surprised by a 32nd file.
R19 (banned files) / code_style 24 (state files) — CLEAN. No .ci-result.json, .submit-state.json, .feedback-state.json, SUMMARY.md, test-report, *.log, .build-context-*, __pycache__ or .DS_Store. Extensions present: .b64 .c .json .kv .md .py .txt .yaml .yml only.
R26 (same-name system lib) — N/A. Only -lm is linked (Makefile `LIB?=-lm`); rtl_wmbus.c includes no librtlsdr header, and the only rtl_sdr references are help text and a commented example pipeline. The empty requirements() is factually correct, so R36 has no unpublished dependency.
R40 (deep adaptation) — SATISFIED with substantive verification rather than patches. The POSIX-only paths upstream guards behind WINDOWS_BUILD (alarm(5)/sigaction(SIGALRM) at rtl_wmbus.c:71-74,1235-1245; net_support.h) are real, compiled in for OHOS, and are genuinely exercised at runtime by ohos_special_test (the -f probe really times out and exits non-zero), while the ELF/DT_NEEDED assertions pin the OHOS aarch64 musl ABI.
R51 (upstream-test three-step method) — CLEAN, truthfully backfilled. The 4 upstream captures are inventoried in MANIFEST.yml/manifest.yaml and each was re-run against an independent build from the official source: issue48 `-d 3 -s -o` -> 2 lines T1 (claimed 2, T1); issue47 `-o` -> 8 lines T1+C1 (claimed 8, T1+C1); issue49 `-o` -> 4 lines T1 (claimed 4, T1); samples2 default -> 4 lines T1 including two 0;0 CRC-failed frames (claimed 4, "T1 with 0;0 CRC-fail"). Every reported number and mode reproduces exactly. The author also discloses honestly that only 1 of 4 is embedded as an automated fixture (with a byte-verified size/provenance rationale in gen_fixture.py) and that the upstream `make check` target does not exist.
code_style compliance — CLEAN. Shebang + docstring on all three Python files; class names RtlWmbusConan / RtlWmbusTestConan; package_type "application" correct for a CLI tool; method order layout->source->generate->build->package->package_info; cpp_info.libs=[] and cpp_info.bindirs=["bin"] set; `from conan import ConanFile` (not `from conans`); 2-space YAML/JSON indent with quoted strings; zero CRLF, zero missing trailing newlines, zero placeholder leftovers (the one "XXX" hit is a coincidental substring inside the base64 fixture, not a marker).

=== AREAS DELIBERATELY NOT RAISED (checked, judged non-issues) ===
- `category: radio` is outside the illustrative category list in templates/manifest-software.yaml, but that list is a non-exhaustive comment and ~30 other unlisted categories are already in use across merged packages, including science, bio, games and reverse-engineering.
- All 15 files are committed mode 100755 (executable bit on .yaml/.md/.b64). No rule in the loaded rule set covers file modes, and 1640 other files under archives/ already carry 100755, so this is the prevailing repo state rather than a defect introduced here.
- The PT_INTERP check accepts only /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1, whereas archives/l/libomxil/0.9.3/test_package/test.c (H4) accepts both that and /lib/ld-musl-aarch64.so.1. Not raised: the header comment already discloses the musl-vs-glibc ambiguity explicitly and labels this check as layout-only, the author recorded first-hand measured output for this exact build (`file` output recorded in notes.md and manifest.yaml artifact), and the real discriminating power is carried by the exact-soname DT_NEEDED checks 12/13, which were proven non-vacuous in this round.
- `url = ""  # CI fills this` appears in code_style 5 as a banned template placeholder, but it is verbatim the repository template templates/conanfile-makefile.py.tmpl and is used by 1534 existing files; notes.md 6.1 documents the justification. Repo convention, not a leftover.
- archives/r/rtl-wmbus/1.1.0/test_package/metadata/ exists in the working tree as an empty leftover of an earlier in-repo conan run. It is empty, untracked by git, absent from HEAD and invisible to `git status --porcelain`, so it is not part of the PR.

CONCLUSION: no issue of any severity remains open on the audited content. All six R5 findings are confirmed fixed; the deception-class rules (R34/R9/R8/R19/R40/R51) are clean with independent empirical proof rather than reliance on the author's claims; and the recipe correctness rules (R26/R32/R33/R36/R37/R38/R39) are clean after this round's correction of R39. One honesty note recorded against this report's own earlier revisions: it previously (a) recorded R39 CLEAN and (b) asserted "preflight PF1-PF8 全部通过", and both statements were untrue of the audited content — they survived only because no round had actually executed preflight against the changed conandata.yml. Both are corrected above. verdict=pass; the PR may proceed.

findings.issue: sources.url 手写 gh-proxy 镜像前缀作为首个条目，违反 R39 并被 preflight PF7 机械拦截；且因 CI 的镜像注入正则只匹配单值 url，已展开的列表反而屏蔽了 CI 自身的镜像回退注入。本条为本轮复核实跑 preflight 才发现，平台验视与前 6 轮 W4 审计均未捕获。
findings.evidence: python3 scripts/ohc/preflight.py . 255e5069 HEAD -> [FAIL] PF7 源URL闸(R39): conandata.yml:19 镜像前缀 gh-proxy.com（CI 自动加镜像回退，手写即 R39 违规 579 例）
findings.root_cause: commit 5671aeacc（题为 PT_INTERP 断言修复）误将 CI 门禁镜像注入后的工作树残留当作源码提交；被提交的列表与 build_and_test.sh get_mirrors() 对 github.com 的返回值逐字符相同，即 ['https://gh-proxy.com/' + url, url]
findings.verification: sources.url 回退为官方单值 URL 后 preflight 仅剩既有 PF9；同源门禁 GATE_EXIT_CODE=0、1/1 成功、test_decode 19 checks / ohos_special_test 13 checks 均 0 failures，且日志首次出现 "[ok] Source URLs rewritten with mirror fallback"

post_local_review_remediation.report_binding_note: 绑定语义说明（重要，避免自指死循环）：audit-result.json 无法包含自身所在提交的 SHA，因此 head/head_full 绑定的是「最后一次改动被审计内容」的提交 56fcb796e72ade2052867e62a41b36ff497dd59f，而「被审计内容」由 audited_content_sha256 唯一确定，且该摘要刻意排除本文件自身。重绑提交只改本报告文件、不触碰任何构建输入，故重绑后 audited_content_sha256 不变——这使绑定既稳定又可独立复验。复验命令见 audited_content_verify_cmd 字段。
post_local_review_remediation.counts_note: counts 字段仍为 W4 审计自身的 P0-P3 计数（全 0），本地验视发现的 P1/P2 记于 post_local_review_remediation.findings，两者不混淆。
post_local_review_remediation.audited_content_verify_cmd: git diff --name-only $(git merge-base origin/main <HEAD>) <HEAD> | grep -v 'reports/audit-result.json' | sort | while read -r f; do printf '%s  %s\n' "$(git show <HEAD>:"$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" "$f"; done | sha256sum

report_binding.head_full_binds: 最后一次改动被审计内容的提交
report_binding.self_reference: audit-result.json 无法包含自身提交 SHA；重绑提交不改变被审计内容，摘要因此稳定
report_binding.note: R52 要求审计报告绑定最终提交；此处的等价可核验形式是「内容摘要 + 绑定提交」二者并存
